items.label: MAKE & RECEIVE CALLS
items.value: Bluetooth calling plus message/social app notifications—stay connected without pulling out your phone.

items.label: IP69K RUGGED DURABILITY
items.value: Sealed against water, dust, and impacts—built for tough jobs and hard training, indoors and out.

items.label: 7 GPS OUTDOOR MODES
items.value: Track walking, running, cycling, skiing, snowboarding, mountaineering, and cross-country with mapped routes and precise metrics.

items.label: REAL-TIME HEALTH METRICS
items.value: Heart rate, SpO₂, stress, steps, calories, and activity tracking to monitor daily performance.

items.label: ALTIMETER, BAROMETER & COMPASS
items.value: Essential ABC tools for elevation, pressure, and direction on worksites and trails.

items.label: 170+ SPORTS MODES
items.value: From running to swimming and extreme sports; analyze trends to improve training over time.

items.label: GORILLA GLASS DISPLAY
items.value: Reinforced screen for clarity and scratch resistance in demanding environments.

items.label: THICKER, TOUGHER STRAPS
items.value: Reinforced bands keep the watch secure during heavy work and intense workouts.

items.label: SLEEP & BREATHING SUPPORT
items.value: Sleep stages with insights and breathing reminders to help maintain daily balance.

items.label: CARBINOX PRO APP
items.value: Sync with Android/iOS for maps, records, custom watch faces, and deeper fitness analytics.
